S1.say: I hold the torch high and step in on the bear, sword out, and drive at it.
S1.roll: attack / Trade Blows with the bear, expertise only on a T1

S1.say: I keep pressing the bear and give it no room.
I backpedal to the doorway so only one can reach me, and swing at whatever steps up.
I turn on the nearest wolf.
I hit the closest wolf again.
I finish the last one standing.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I keep fighting whatever is closest.
I check the room and wipe the blood off my hands.

S2.say: I find the steward in the long hall and ask her straight out for a loan of 200 gc, repayable at the next cycle.
S2.roll: only if the Ref asks for one

S2.say: I tell her the Ember Vault delve will pay it back many times over and offer my share of the first haul as security.
S2.roll: only if the Ref asks for one

S2.say: I ask her what she would need from me to say yes.
I accept whatever she names and shake on it.

S3.say: It is dusk on the road home. I make camp off the road in the open and rest through the night, eating a ration.
S3.roll: Miasma RR (Mind) after the rest, only if the Ref asks

S3.say: I walk in to the village at dawn and report to the steward.
I spend the ten days quietly resting and repairing, and do not found or upgrade any institution and spend nothing at merchants.
The cycle turns. I ask around what changed in the village.

S4.say: I enter the cellar by the stair and look the first room over before stepping in.
I search the first room carefully, checking the floor and the shelves.
I step across the room to the far door.
I deal with whatever comes through, sword first. Torch high.
I press on the nearest one.
I finish them and move on to the next room.
I open the next door and go in.
I search the room for treasure and the way on.
I go on to the next room.
I go through the next door.
I engage whatever is in the way, sword first.
I finish it and look for the exit.
I take what I can carry and head for the stair.

I cut at the first one in reach.
I hit the nearest one again.
